trailhead.label: Heating plant, Sexten, the board’s start

cautions: A long climb of over 800 m, steep in places: plan rests and water for your dog.
No staffed hut on the way: carry food and water.
Open ridge and meadows at about 2,000 m: turn back if a storm builds.
Carry water even though water points are listed.
Follow local signs, lead rules and temporary closures.

emergency.note: Call the European emergency number when urgent help is required. Connectivity is not guaranteed.

textIt.Heating plant, Sexten, the board’s start: Centrale di teleriscaldamento, Sexten, la partenza indicata dalla scheda ufficiale
textIt.A long climb of over 800 m, steep in pla: Una lunga salita di oltre 800 m, ripida in alcuni tratti: prevedi soste e acqua per il tuo cane.
textIt.No staffed hut on the way: carry food an: Nessun rifugio gestito lungo il percorso: porta cibo e acqua.
textIt.Open ridge and meadows at about 2,000 m:: Cresta e prati aperti a circa 2.000 m: torna indietro se si forma un temporale.
